universal_lens: Semantic video tagging enables structured retrieval of sports actions via feature vectors embedded in temporal frames. A 61-parameter kinematic model with 58 rotational and 3 translational degrees-of-freedom enables articulated motion tracking via DoF hierarchy and spine deformation modeling.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian belief updates on tagged video features inform coach-athlete decision-making under uncertainty using conformal predictive distributions. Bayesian inference maps observed video frames to posterior distributions over actor-specific body models using maximum overlap similarity optimization and DoF parameter estimation.
gse_mapping: Situationally grounded state transitions in motion capture derive from real-time feature tagging and probabilistic action prediction kernels. Situational reasoning transitions between pose states by optimizing kinematic constraints across DoF hierarchies, enabling real-time tracking and level-of-detail adaptation.
